decriminalization.summary: § 175 of the criminal code, which criminalised sex between men, was repealed in 1994. The same age-of-consent rules now apply to everyone.

marriage.summary: Civil marriage is open to two people of the same sex under § 1353 of the civil code, as amended in 2017 ("Ehe für alle").

genderRecognition.summary: Self-declaration at the registry office under the Selbstbestimmungsgesetz, in force since 1 November 2024. A three-month waiting period applies between the declaration of intent and the change.

sources.label: SBGG — Gesetz über die Selbstbestimmung in Bezug auf den Geschlechtseintrag

conversionTherapy.summary: Conversion treatments are banned for anyone under 18 and for adults whose consent is impaired. There is no blanket ban covering all adults.

sources.label: KonvBehSchG — Gesetz zum Schutz vor Konversionsbehandlungen

asylum.summary: Claims based on sexual orientation or gender identity are assessed as membership of a particular social group. The EU qualification rules apply directly in Germany.
